title: Stagewise overlap comparison data family
statement: For the fixed two-open overlap and supplied local identifications, comparison data of the prescribed type exists simultaneously for every later index in the directed system.

source.place: Tag 09RE, restriction of perfect complexes and derived pullback along the affine limit system.

proof.text: Construct the finite-stage restriction and pullback comparison diagrams from the affine limit cocone and the supplied local isomorphisms; the same cartesian restriction construction works independently at each later index.

proof_origin.note: The stagewise data family is isolated as an intermediate existence theorem.
